title: Getting Started with ALM WebFlow Studio
description: A short guided walkthrough of the WebFlow lifecycle.

steps.title: Automation Library
steps.instruction: Start here to open an existing WebFlow or create a new one.

steps.title: Record
steps.instruction: Launch the controlled browser and capture a repeatable web process.

steps.title: Object Repository
steps.instruction: Review resilient selectors and classify inputs, outputs, assertions, and secrets.

steps.title: Designer
steps.instruction: Add conditions, loops, variables, waits, subflows, or governed Python when needed.

steps.title: Execute
steps.instruction: Run immediately, place work on the queue, or schedule it for later.

steps.title: Measure
steps.instruction: Use synthetic runs to review timing distributions, failures, console errors, and network issues.
